outcome: successful management of PA-AML and cardiac disease
cohort: A 31-year-old pregnant woman at 38 weeks' gestational age diagnosed with acute myeloid leukemia and partial atrioventricular septal defect.
finding: An efficient multidisciplinary approach is essential in the management of PA-AML and cardiac disease, and minimally invasive cardiac surgery may be safe and useful in patients with AML.
mod_finding: An urgent cesarean section was performed as part of the multidisciplinary management strategy for the patient's conditions.
